programs.title: Life after life
programs.desc: When journalist Masha finally gives up trying to find happiness with Dmitry, an older man who was also her boss, she falls for the much younger Yuri Kozakov - handsome, attentive and seemingly wealthy. But after a hasty marriage, Masha soon begins to notices strange things about Yuri's lifestyle and behaviour. When Yuri leaves for a business trip, Masha hears footsteps in the house and sees a dark shadow in the garden. Soon she will learn Yuri's horrible secret and become threatened by mortal danger, but if she cannot save herself, who will come to her aid in her hour of need?

programs.title: Pineville Heist
programs.desc: On a routine walk in the woods, a high schooler stumbles into the aftermath of a bank robbery gone wrong. He soon finds himself locked within the schoolgrounds, desperate to keep himself and his teacher alive as one of the psychotic thieves hunts them down.

programs.title: Prodigy
programs.desc: A mother concerned about her young son's disturbing behavior thinks something supernatural may be affecting him.

programs.title: Anti Matter
programs.desc: A Ph.D. student finds herself unable to make new memories after a failed wormhole experiment.

programs.title: The Duplicate
programs.desc: When Jessica asks her twin sister Alessandra for help with a blackmailer she gets more than she bargained for.
